patterns.syntax: explicit character classes such as [0-9] and [^ \t\r\n]; no \s, \d, \w, \b or '.', which mean different things in Python, the JVM and Android's ICU, except in [\s\S], which is any character in all three

identifiers.imei: a 15-digit token that passes the Luhn check
identifiers.imsi: a 14- or 15-digit token starting with 2 to 7 (a mobile country code)
identifiers.iccid: a 19- or 20-digit token starting with 89, optionally ending in F
